notes.title: [Patch note: Build0621] Fix for various issues
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that caused an error in gallery mode
- Fixed an issue where the fast display of read text was not working
- Fixed an issue where the setting to change the color of read text was not working properly
- Added a missing credit to the ending
- Fixed an issue where the hair in the standing picture was displayed differently than intended

notes.title: [Patch note: Build0611] Fixed an issue with fonts
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where unintended fonts were used in some environments.

notes.content:
